title: What is Metro Bundler?
overview: Metro Bundler is the JavaScript bundler used by React Native. It reads your application's source code, combines all JavaScript files and dependencies into a single bundle, and serves it to your application during development. Metro also supports Fast Refresh, allowing changes to appear instantly without rebuilding the entire application.

title: How Metro Bundler Works
overview: When you start Metro Bundler, it scans your project, resolves all imported files, bundles them together, and serves them to your application. Every time you save a file, Metro detects the change, rebuilds only the affected files, and updates the application automatically.

example.title: Metro Workflow
example.content: Write Code → Save File → Metro Bundles Changes → App Updates Automatically

title: Fast Refresh
overview: Fast Refresh is a feature provided by Metro that updates your application immediately after you save changes. It helps developers test UI updates quickly without restarting the entire application, making development much faster.

example.title: Real-World Example
example.content: You change the text inside a <Text> component and press Save. Within a second, the updated text appears in the app without reinstalling or rebuilding it.

title: Clearing Metro Cache
overview: Sometimes Metro may continue using old cached files, leading to unexpected errors. Clearing the Metro cache forces it to rebuild everything from scratch, which often resolves these issues.

title: Topic Summary
overview: You learned what Metro Bundler is, how it bundles JavaScript files, how Fast Refresh improves development speed, and how to clear the Metro cache when troubleshooting issues.

example.title: Quick Revision
example.content:
✔ Metro bundles JavaScript files.
✔ It serves the bundle to your app.
✔ Fast Refresh updates the app instantly.
✔ Use --reset-cache to clear Metro's cache.
